title: DTU Tuition Fee Waiver for International non-EU/EEA MSc Students
program_type: Merit-based tuition fee waiver awarded with admission
duration: A tuition fee waiver will cover the tuition fee for two years
description: DTU awards a very limited number of tuition fee waivers to new international non-EU/EEA MSc students applying for the autumn intake, allocating them to students with excellent academic performance. title: Copenhagen Business School Danish Government Scholarship
duration: We have a wide selection of courses at CBS, so you are likely to find something that matches your interests. In autumn semesters we also offer minors.
description: If you are taking courses at Summer University to qualify for admission to a master programme at CBS, you should make sure that you choose the correct courses.

title: University of Copenhagen Danish Government Scholarship
program_type: Government scholarship administered by the university, tuition waiver and/or living-cost grant
duration: Master's programme length; separate limited second-year scholarships are awarded by some faculties after the first year
description: The University of Copenhagen offers a limited number of tuition waivers and grants through the Danish Government Scholarship programme, awarded competitively to highly talented non-EU/EEA students with outstanding academic records. All eligible non-EU/EEA applicants to the university's MA/MSc programmes are considered automatically as part of the admission process, so no individual application exists. The award is granted as a full or partial tuition fee waiver and/or an amount covering basic living expenses, depending on faculty, and is decided on academic achievement alone.

title: Aarhus University Danish State Scholarship
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (full or part; some faculties add a monthly living-expense grant)
duration: Duration of the Master's programme (monthly grant 'typically but not always' for the programme)
description: Aarhus University administers a limited number of Danish state scholarships for non-EU/EEA applicants liable to pay tuition fees. The award takes the form of a full or partial tuition waiver; the Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS add a monthly grant towards living expenses, while the Faculty of Natural Sciences and the Faculty of Technical Sciences offer tuition waivers only. No separate scholarship application exists: applicants are assessed automatically when they apply for admission to a Master's programme by 15 January (summer admission) or 15 September (winter admission). title: Master International Scholarship – Bergen
duration: Up to two years of full tuition fees
description: The Master International Scholarship – Bergen is awarded to applicants with a strong academic record admitted to any MSc programme at BI's Bergen campus. It covers full tuition fees for up to two years provided the student maintains the scholarship recipients' academic progression requirements, and no living-expense stipend is stated for this award. Eligibility requires international citizenship without Norwegian residency and a minimum overall GPA of 4.0 on the ECTS scale, and only candidates seeking their first master's degree are considered.
